QuestInfo.name: [Fox Valley] Grow, Tree, Grow!
QuestInfo.0: Master Crafter #b#p3002020##k is at it again. He needs the supplies you collected to make his magic fertilizer. You should talk to him in #b#m410000118##k.
QuestInfo.1:
The smell that 'magic' fertilizer is giving off is redefining the meaning of revolting. But if the magic is even half as powerful as that stench, then this plan just might work.

Give it a shot, and use the #i4036318##t4036318# on #b#p3002019##k in #b#m410000118##k.
QuestInfo.2:
"Grow, tree, grow!"

That tiny tree shot up like a rocket the moment #b#p3002020##k started chanting and pouring fertilizer on it! Maybe that fox is craftier than you thought.
